title.zh-CN: 足月妊娠头痛与重度血小板减少 · 21岁女性
title.en: Term pregnancy, headache and severe thrombocytopenia · woman aged 21

summary.zh-CN: 妊娠晚期神经症状、贫血与血小板减少，需要动态区别产科疾病与血栓性微血管病。
summary.en: Late-pregnancy neurological symptoms, anaemia and thrombocytopenia require evolving distinction between obstetric disease and thrombotic microangiopathy.

provenance.citation: 龚洵, 邓东锐. 妊娠期血栓性血小板减少性紫癜一例. 中华产科急救电子杂志. 2013;02(03):212-214. doi:10.3877/cma.j.issn.2095-3259.2013.03.015.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

reviewers: AI-assisted editorial source and guidance check; not a licensed clinician
guidelines: ISTH. 2025 focused update of the 2020 TTP management guidelines; acute suspected TTP assessment remains urgent. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13470878/
ISTH. Guidelines for diagnosis of TTP. 2020. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8146131/

notes.zh-CN: 已对照所列权威资料进行人工智能辅助编辑核对；未由执业医师审核。原报告罕见表现及方案仍需专科确认。
notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别分娩后持续神经和血液异常的再评估信号。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify persistent postpartum neurological and haematological abnormalities as reassessment triggers.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分TMA表型与TTP特异性确证。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a TMA phenotype from TTP-specific confirmation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释紧急专科处置不应等待全部检验。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why urgent specialist care should not await every test.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 及时识别疑似TTP急症，不把历史反复输板作为默认正确处置
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise suspected TTP urgently without treating historical repeated platelet transfusions as default care

prompt.zh-CN: 分娩后持续恶化要求哪种再评估？
prompt.en: What reassessment is required by deterioration after delivery?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 血栓性微血管病，包括TTP及其他妊娠相关TMA
text.en: Thrombotic microangiopathy, including TTP and other pregnancy-associated TMAs

feedback.zh-CN: 重度血小板减少、神经受累及溶血线索不能只归于已终止的妊娠。
feedback.en: Severe thrombocytopenia, neurological injury and haemolysis clues require more than attribution to the completed pregnancy.

text.zh-CN: 分娩即可保证所有产科相关异常会自行消失
text.en: Delivery guarantees spontaneous resolution of all abnormalities

feedback.zh-CN: 实际持续恶化需要重新判断。

text.zh-CN: 孤立免疫性血小板减少足以解释全部
text.en: Isolated immune thrombocytopenia explains everything

feedback.zh-CN: 不能充分解释缺血、破碎红细胞和LDH升高。
feedback.en: It does not adequately explain ischaemia, schistocytes and LDH elevation.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 临床高度疑TMA，报告称TTP但缺ADAMTS13分型证据
text.en: TMA is strongly suspected; the report labels TTP without ADAMTS13 subtype confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 应保留TTP与其他TMA之间的确证边界。
feedback.en: Retain the confirmation boundary between TTP and other TMAs.

text.zh-CN: 大量破碎红细胞已特异确证免疫性TTP
text.en: Schistocytes specifically prove immune TTP

feedback.zh-CN: 它们支持微血管性溶血，不特异确定病因。
feedback.en: They support microangiopathic haemolysis, not one cause.

text.zh-CN: 初始CT正常可排除后续脑缺血
text.en: An initially normal CT excludes later cerebral ischaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 后续MRI已记录缺血，检查时点和敏感性不同。
feedback.en: Later MRI documented ischaemia; timing and modality differ.

prompt.zh-CN: 今天回顾这种高危组合，应优先什么？
prompt.en: What should be prioritised when reviewing this high-risk combination today?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 立即血液与重症会诊，及时送ADAMTS13并按高度疑TTP急症路径评估血浆置换等，避免常规预防性输板
text.en: Urgent haematology/critical-care review, prompt ADAMTS13 sampling and emergency suspected-TTP assessment including plasma exchange; avoid routine prophylactic platelet transfusion

feedback.zh-CN: 不能等待全部确证才处理危及生命的TMA；出血或紧急操作另行个体化。
feedback.en: Life-threatening TMA should not await complete confirmation; bleeding or urgent procedures require individual assessment.

text.zh-CN: 唯一目标是反复输板把数值补正常
text.en: Repeated platelet transfusion to normalise the count is the sole goal

feedback.zh-CN: 忽略病因性微血管血栓且可能不安全。
feedback.en: This neglects the microthrombotic process and may be unsafe.

text.zh-CN: 继续等待一周看分娩是否起效
text.en: Wait another week to see whether delivery works

feedback.zh-CN: 神经和器官恶化需要立即升级。
feedback.en: Neurological and organ deterioration require immediate escalation.

text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 及时识别疑似TTP急症，不把历史反复输板作为默认正确处置
text.en: Recognise suspected TTP urgently without treating historical repeated platelet transfusions as default care

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别分娩后持续神经和血液异常的再评估信号。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：ADAMTS13、抑制物、完整溶血资料、是否实际实施血浆置换及离院后结局。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Identify persistent postpartum neurological and haematological abnormalities as reassessment triggers. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: ADAMTS13, inhibitors, complete haemolysis results, whether plasma exchange occurred and post-discharge outcome. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 妊娠相关严重TMA的历史不良结局，原报告TTP诊断缺ADAMTS13确证。
conclusion.en: A severe pregnancy-associated TMA with an adverse historical course; the reported TTP diagnosis lacks ADAMTS13 confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 识别分娩后持续神经和血液异常的再评估信号。
keyReasoning.en: Identify persistent postpartum neurological and haematological abnormalities as reassessment triggers.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 区分TMA表型与TTP特异性确证。
keyReasoning.en: Distinguish a TMA phenotype from TTP-specific confirmation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别分娩后持续神经和血液异常的再评估信号。
teachingPoints.en: Identify persistent postpartum neurological and haematological abnormalities as reassessment triggers.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分TMA表型与TTP特异性确证。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish a TMA phenotype from TTP-specific confirmation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: ADAMTS13、抑制物、完整溶血资料、是否实际实施血浆置换及离院后结局。
unknowns.en: ADAMTS13, inhibitors, complete haemolysis results, whether plasma exchange occurred and post-discharge outcome.

testUtterances.text: 头痛和眼花什么时候开始的？
When did the headache and visual symptoms begin?
这次头痛是突然出现的吗？
How did this headache start?
左边麻了多久，后来恢复了吗？
How long did the left-sided numbness last, and did it resolve?
麻木是一过性还是一直持续？
Was the numbness transient or persistent?
现在怀孕多少周，是第几次怀孕？
How many weeks pregnant are you, and is this your first pregnancy?
以前生过孩子吗？
Have you delivered a baby before?
以前产检血压和尿蛋白怎样？
What did earlier antenatal BP and urine tests show?
之前有被告知血压偏高吗？
Had you previously been told your blood pressure was raised?
孕期有定期检查吗？
Were antenatal checks regular?
产检以前发现过异常吗？
Had earlier antenatal visits found abnormalities?
有没有鼻出血、牙龈出血或其他出血？
Has there been nose, gum or other bleeding?
以前有异常出血记录吗？
Are unusual bleeding episodes recorded?
对哪些药物过敏？
Which medicines have caused allergy?
用药后出现过什么过敏反应？
What allergic reactions have occurred after medicines?
以前有没有出血自诉方面的情况？
Could you describe any reported bleeding?
以前有没有用药过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any drug allergy?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
